title: Invariant Override
description: In-source override of a non-constitutional, non-hard-fail invariant. Parsed from `// inv-override:` annotation blocks in source files. Absorbs the LAW-00.OVERRIDE.1 mechanism from the stech-law predecessor draft (D-38). Constitutional and hard-fail invariants cannot be overridden — they require an Architect amendment.

invariant_id.description: The invariant being overridden. The invariant's severity MUST be gate, warn, or advisory.

file.description: Repo-relative path of the source file containing the annotation.

line.description: 1-based line number of the `// inv-override:` line.

expires.description: Expiry: `YYYY-Qx` (quarter) or `YYYY-MM-DD`. CI rejects expired overrides.

approver.description: GitHub handle of the override approver.

adr.description: Optional ADR id justifying the override pattern.
